// Board-side construction of U8G2_KS0108_128X64_F for target 'main'.
// A starting point for your firmware's board file (e.g. board.h), not
// generated code: U8G2GL describes the panel; the pins and bus are your board's.

#include <U8g2lib.h>
#include "ui.hpp"  // generated by u8g2gl, in the project's output directory

// Replace each FILL_IN_PIN with your board's pin; the build stops until you do.
#define DISPLAY_D0     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D0
#define DISPLAY_D1     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D1
#define DISPLAY_D2     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D2
#define DISPLAY_D3     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D3
#define DISPLAY_D4     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D4
#define DISPLAY_D5     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D5
#define DISPLAY_D6     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D6
#define DISPLAY_D7     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's D7
#define DISPLAY_ENABLE FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's ENABLE
#define DISPLAY_DC     FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's DC
#define DISPLAY_CS0    FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's CS0
#define DISPLAY_CS1    FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's CS1
#define DISPLAY_CS2    FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's CS2
#define DISPLAY_RESET  FILL_IN_PIN  // GPIO wired to the panel's RESET, or U8X8_PIN_NONE (U8G2's default)

// U8G2GL_TARGET_ROTATION comes from ui.hpp; at this target's rotation it is U8G2_R0.
U8G2_KS0108_128X64_F display(
    U8G2GL_TARGET_ROTATION,
    DISPLAY_D0,
    DISPLAY_D1,
    DISPLAY_D2,
    DISPLAY_D3,
    DISPLAY_D4,
    DISPLAY_D5,
    DISPLAY_D6,
    DISPLAY_D7,
    DISPLAY_ENABLE,
    DISPLAY_DC,
    DISPLAY_CS0,
    DISPLAY_CS1,
    DISPLAY_CS2,
    DISPLAY_RESET);

void setup() {
    display.begin();
    if (!ui_display_matches(display)) {
        /* the panel or rotation differs from target 'main' */
    }
    ui_init();
}
